notes: New voice mode: a full-screen voice screen with a living orb, live captions, Mute and End. Go to another app and Colon stays with you as a small pill at the top of the screen (tap it for a full-screen glow, hold or swipe it to end); allow "Display over other apps" to use it. Updates are now checked every 15 minutes.

browser.notes: Released alongside Colon AI 0.20.0. No changes to the browser itself.
